Theme

Latin word

satis

adverb; also an indeclinable noun with a genitive, and with esse, “to be enough”

enough; quite, fairly, well enough

In this lexicon

  • enough

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. Ep. 1.7.16: jam satis est; Cic. Att. 6.2.2: habeō negōtī satis

  • quite

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 3.58: nec īnfacētus et satis litterātus; Cic. Off. 2.89: satis bene pāscere

  • nōn satis: too little

    classical

Examples

  • Satis est.

    That’s enough.composed
